shared_model: Existing GoalPlanProposal/GoalScopeView; same entry by execution mode, no new DSL

goal_node_acceptance.native_cancel: No mutation/no rejection receipt; explicit Reject is separate fixed native action using private approvals.decline

goal_graph_runs.cancel.result: GraphRun cancellation-intent receipt, not stop proof

goal_graph_runs.advance_plan.result: GraphRun adopt receipt; same-scope/no new permissions/history retained

private_only.approvals.finalize: Only fixed Native kind verified, full exact snapshot/CAS/current references; never generic renderer approve
private_only.approvals.decline: Only explicit fixed Native Reject; proposal/run/node/current-ref CAS; blocks rejected node, no TaskAccepted

authority: new Native graph kind explicitly grants definition reuse and same-workspace subject rebinding
old per-attempt policies/receipts and old goal_execution do not grant this
artifact integrity/data-schema/command-declared results never by themselves GoalAcceptance
TaskAccepted only all required exact-version criteria/outputs/nodes satisfied
root-grant/project/global/ancestor history and ordinary-session gate unchanged

owner_finalizer_result.task_accepted: boolean; only whole graph criteria completion may be true

snapshot_limits_note: Core checks exact full serialized proposal row and event/envelope overhead <=1048576; snapshot must leave overhead, no truncation; old kind16KiB unchanged.

new_optional_task_fields.acceptance_ref: string|null; required nonempty only for accepted

task_projection.graph_details_projection: GraphTaskAcceptance in goal_graph.rs, not yet runtime tested
task_projection.no_reopen: accepted task terminal; no automatic scheduler/ordinary session/legacy advance restart or budget reset

proposal_recovery.propose: exact original intent+runCAS+key history before freshIO/CAS; return current stored proposal consumed state
proposal_recovery.finalize_decline: same action exact proposal/key returns original decision receipt; cross action conflict
proposal_recovery.foreign_current_node: another key accepting same node never resolves original unknown
proposal_recovery.unconsumed: original proposal must still pass all current exact refs/CAS and fresh witness

read_only_observation_projection.encoding: serde_json compact serialization of the original persisted observation Value; SHA-256 UTF-8 bytes exactly equals result_digest
read_only_observation_projection.authority: display-only; stored GraphValidationReceipt, native Owner snapshot validation_refs, original Value and authenticated receipt/event digests remain unchanged
read_only_observation_projection.limits: complete Details including both forms remains <=4194304 serialized bytes; all existing predecode raw aggregate limits remain
read_only_observation_projection.numeric_metadata: Raw display preserves full Rust u64/f64 JSON without relying on JavaScript number roundtrip. Identity/CAS/pin authorization guards remain unchanged.

task_request_fields.authority: only trusted stored graph capability permits graph additions; legacy exact field set is unchanged
